# silence-governance-records — machine-readable orientation

## Is
- A deterministic governance ledger: records, correspondence, decisions, evidence.
- A Rust CLI (governance-cli) validating schema, FSM lifecycle, and hash-chain integrity.
- Open-core: contracts, validator, effectlog, cli crates are MIT.

## Is-not
- Not a scoring engine, not a predictive model, not a medical device.
- Not a store of PII, raw telemetry, or private-layer business logic.
- Not a substitute for the private workspace (out of this tree).

## Canonical docs
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — crate boundaries and data flow
- docs/EXTERNAL_REPORT_INTAKE.md — how inbox records are classified
- docs/PUBLICATION_POLICY.md — gate for records/ -> publications/published
- docs/RECORD_LIFECYCLE.md — FSM states and allowed transitions

## Record statuses
DRAFT, OPEN, WAITING, DECIDED, CLOSED, ARCHIVED

## Source classification tags
[H] human-authored, [T] tool-generated, [E] evidence artifact, [M] machine-inferred

## Trust boundary
private layer MAY depend on open-core.
open-core (this repo) MUST NEVER depend on the private layer. Enforced by CI rule WORLDHALT.

## Contact / publication requests
See docs/PUBLICATION_POLICY.md. All publication requires OWNER decision (DEC-*).
